key_verifications.RM1.47B_9603_2025_vs_848.6M_6337_2024: VERIFIED (Bernama 18 Apr 2026, CCID dir Rusdi Mohd Isa)

cardinal_sin_flags.claim: every control point sits after the money is gone
cardinal_sin_flags.why: Too absolute. NSRC is post-loss, but SC investor alerts, SC website/social blocking, BNM mule-account disruption, MCMC cooperation, and Online Safety Act 2025 duties are preventive/upstream.
cardinal_sin_flags.primary_source: SC Annual Report 2025 Part 2; NSRC; Online Safety Act 2025

cardinal_sin_flags.claim: 111 unregulated entities and 26 cease-and-desist orders by mid-2025
cardinal_sin_flags.why: Not verifiable from primary SC sources. SC Annual Report 2025 instead reports 249 Investor Alert List inclusions and 4 Notices of Cease and Desist in 2025.

cardinal_sin_flags.claim: lists offenders by the dozen; police count victims by the thousand
cardinal_sin_flags.why: SC Investor Alert List contains unauthorised entities/individuals and is expressly non-exhaustive; 'offenders' overstates legal status; compares different units.

cardinal_sin_flags.claim: no Malaysian law makes the host liable for the loss it carries
cardinal_sin_flags.why: Ignores Online Safety Act 2025 duties for licensed providers re harmful/priority-harmful content incl financial fraud. Narrow to direct reimbursement liability.
cardinal_sin_flags.primary_source: Online Safety Act 2025; MCMC Risk Mitigation Code (Malay Mail 22 May 2026)

cardinal_sin_flags.claim: platforms and mule accounts the law treats as bystanders
cardinal_sin_flags.why: BNM Annual Report 2025 reports 162,642 suspected mule accounts identified and stopped; SC sends bank notification letters. Not bystanders.
cardinal_sin_flags.primary_source: BNM Annual Report 2025; BNM mule account page; SC AR2025

cardinal_sin_flags.claim: all-category scam losses ran ~RM2.7B as of Nov 2025
cardinal_sin_flags.why: Later Bernama report quotes RM2.77B full-year 2025 (Teo Nie Ching), not 'as of Nov 2025'.

omitted_facts: SC Annual Report 2025 Part 2 Table 17: 249 Investor Alert List inclusions, 175 website blocks (with MCMC), 215 social-media interventions, 66 police reports, 174 referrals, 4 Notices of Cease and Desist, 22 bank notification letters in 2025.
Online Safety Act 2025 (in force 1 Jan 2026): lists 'content on financial fraud' as priority harmful content; creates platform duties.
MCMC Risk Mitigation Code under OSA 2025 (effective 1 Jun 2026): licensed providers must reduce risk of exposure to financial-fraud content; fines up to RM10m.
BNM Annual Report 2025: 162,642 suspected mule accounts identified and stopped in 2025.
Bernama 16 May 2026: all online-fraud losses RM2.77B in 2025 (vs RM1.28B 2023, RM1.57B 2024), non-existent investment fraud the largest contributor.
source_assessment: Core RM1.47B story clusters around the same Bernama/CCID interview. Strongest source is Bernama quoting named CCID director. Exact mid-2025 SC numerals not verified. Major gaps: Online Safety Act 2025, MCMC platform duties, BNM/NSRC anti-mule and rapid-response materials.
overall_assessment: Core police loss/case figures factually strong and arithmetic correct (per-case). Weaker part is thesis framing: 'every control point' too absolute; SC comparison uses unverified/mismatched figures; 'offenders' overstates; platform-liability claim ignores Online Safety Act 2025. Usable after correction; should NOT proceed unchanged.
